critical_code_review_comments: server.py extract_mesh() is well designed: caches by name (bounded to 200 entries with a hard clear when exceeded), centers geometry, applies node world matrix, and returns flat float arrays which are cheap to serialize. Consider LRU rather than full clear at 200 to avoid pathological cache thrash.
PanelPreview.jsx correctly guards click on !mesh with disabled + falls back to Box icon on fetch error via tag-sheet-mark-badge testid (accessibility preserved).
PanelFullscreen.jsx correctly listens for Escape and cleans up on unmount; z-index 60 correctly stacks above TagSheet (50).

Round-trip payload for C1 [6420986] is ~110KB JSON (8136 floats + 16272 indices). For larger panels consider gzipping the mesh endpoint if not already handled by ingress, or delivering as binary (Float32/Uint32) with a custom media type.

/api/objects appears to only expose facade objects (mark starts with C/L+digit) in current data — 200 items sampled were all facade. Not a bug per PRD but worth documenting since UI navigates via this list.
